ambiguity.detail: Unclear what happened three years ago or why the marriage license is disputed.

verdict.hook_line: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A defiant Duke and his wife go toe-to-toe with a corrupt High Priest over the validity of their wedding.
verdict.why_it_works: Strong power-struggle dialogue and a ticking-clock ultimatum that drives viewers to the next episode.
